description: Read-only access to your local Zotero library through the Zotero Reading Bridge plugin (stdio relay to 127.0.0.1).
long_description: Relays MCP messages between Claude Desktop and the Zotero Reading Bridge plugin running inside Zotero 11 on this computer (http://127.0.0.1:<port>/bridge/mcp). The relay is a child process of Claude Desktop: it opens no listening port and only ever connects to 127.0.0.1. All tools are read-only. Nothing about the current Zotero selection is attached to messages automatically; the model calls get_current_context when you refer to the open or selected paper.

port.title: Zotero HTTP port
port.description: Port of Zotero's built-in HTTP server, as shown on the Zotero Reading Bridge settings page. The host is always 127.0.0.1.
